title: Crisp Syrian Chicken Kebabs
description: A flavorful and healthy dish with a zesty twist, featuring chicken kebabs marinated in a mix of spices and herbs.

ingredients.name: syrian zaatar
ingredients.notes: available at most Middle Eastern markets

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together zaatar, lemon juice, olive oil, garlic, and parsley.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours.
Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers.
Grill for 8-10 minutes per side, or until the chicken is cooked through.
